p: “And he shall make atonement for the most holy place [mikdash hakodesh]” … the place that is dedicated [hamkudash] for the Ark [lakodesh].

“And he shall make atonement for the most holy place [mikdash hakodesh]” (Leviticus 16:33), which is interpreted as follows: He will sprinkle the blood to make atonement not specifically on the Ark [hakodesh], but even on the place that is dedicated [hamkudash] for the Ark [lakodesh].
